main.description: The newsletter's standing words, kept as a record so they can be rewritten without a deploy. A singleton at rkey "self". Leaflet keeps the list and sends the email; this holds only what dame.is says around the form, wherever the form is: in a post, on /blogging, and on the newsletter's own page at /blogging/subscribe (whose title and intro are its is.dame.page/subscribe record, like every page's). Every field is optional and every one has a built-in default: an absent field is the sentence the site ships with, not an empty one.

name.description: The newsletter's name, set small above the title of its own page.

heading.description: The form's heading where it sits in a post or on /blogging. The newsletter's own page has its title instead.

thanks.description: What the form says in place of itself once a reader has confirmed their address and come back from Leaflet.

fine.description: The fine print under the email field. {rss} becomes a link to the site's RSS feed, worded "RSS feed".
